drivingQuestion: What is the duration of digestion, after which one may no longer recite the blessing?
outcomeNote: The two reports in Reish Lakish's name are reconciled by the size of the meal; the dispute with R' Yoḥanan is left standing.

segments.he: כַּמָּה שִׁיעוּר עִכּוּל? אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: כׇּל זְמַן שֶׁאֵינוֹ רָעֵב. וְרֵישׁ לָקִישׁ אָמַר: כׇּל זְמַן שֶׁיִּצְמָא מֵחֲמַת אֲכִילָתוֹ.
segments.en: The Gemara asks: «What is the duration of digestion? Rabbi Yoḥanan said:» As «long as he is not» yet «hungry» again. «And Reish Lakish said: As long as he is thirsty due to his eating.»

segments.he: אֲמַר לֵיהּ רַב יֵימַר בַּר שֶׁלֶמְיָא לְמָר זוּטְרָא וְאָמְרִי לַהּ רַב יֵימַר בַּר שֵׁיזְבִי לְמָר זוּטְרָא: מִי אָמַר רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ הָכִי? וְהָאָמַר רַב אַמֵּי אָמַר רֵישׁ לָקִישׁ: כַּמָּה שִׁיעוּר עִכּוּל? — כְּדֵי לְהַלֵּךְ אַרְבַּע מִילִין!
segments.en: «Rav Yeimar bar Shelamya said to Mar Zutra, and some say» that it was «Rav Yeimar bar Sheizevi» who said to «Mar Zutra: Did Reish Lakish say that? Didn’t Rav Ami say» that «Reish Lakish said: What is the duration of digestion? As long as» it takes «to walk four mil?»

segments.he: לָא קַשְׁיָא: כָּאן בַּאֲכִילָה מְרוּבָּה, כָּאן בַּאֲכִילָה מוּעֶטֶת.
segments.en: The Gemara answers: This is «not difficult. Here,» where Reish Lakish said the duration is as long as it takes to walk four mil, is «in» a case where he ate «a sizable meal, here,» where Reish Lakish said the duration is as long as he remains thirsty, is «in» a case where he ate «a meager meal.»
